title: Exact-Adjoint Minimal Implementation Plan
starting_point: V1691.6 consolidated the exact component-dual identity, exact adjoint gradients, and signed dual-transported boundary Q_A.
claim_boundary: Implementation plan only. No emitter, no simulation, no retained field-law validation.
purpose: Define the minimal admissible Python implementation needed to test V1691 without returning to heuristic component projections.

minimal_scope.geometry: small retained graph with at least two adjacent loops
minimal_scope.transport: first-order retained generator approximation T_A ≈ I + A for v0 implementation
minimal_scope.boundary_mode: signed boundary trace with explicit component dual transport ids

allowed_simplifications: Use first-order retained approximation L_A[Xi]≈Xi for the first implementation.
Use identity W_A, W_B, W_S, W_O3 initially if declared before execution.
Use fixed H4 target quotient projector P_perp_q for first implementation.
Use a finite retained test-pair set T_p declared before execution.
Use identity dual transport τ_e→C for v0 only if all edge covectors are already represented in the same declared frame; otherwise emit failure.
forbidden_simplifications: Do not project D_GammaR_Gamma by heuristic basis split.
Do not assign rho_P components by event label only.
Do not compute Q_A from E_source.
Do not use scalar product/O3/H4 defect as gradient.
Do not tune weights after seeing residuals.
Do not aggregate before component residuals are emitted.

module_2_exact_adjoint_gradients: compute delta_oplus and Grad_oplus with D1*/D2*
compute delta_O3 and Grad_O3 with D1*/D2*/D3*
compute delta_H4 and Grad_H4 with quotient admissibility
compute delta_Pi and Grad_Pi using d_Pi*
module_3_stationary_solver: solve A using exact adjoint Grad_total
module_4_curvature_and_current: compute D_GammaR_Gamma in declared dual components
compute rho_P in component dual space using A-induced event action
module_5_boundary_QA: reject Q_A without boundary trace support

required_tables.component_duals.csv: declared component weights, dual rules, admissibility constraints
required_tables.adjoint_gradients.csv: exact adjoint residuals and gradients by edge/component
required_tables.component_identity_residuals.csv: D, rho, Q_A, E by component

stationarity_gate: Grad_total exact-adjoint norm decreases under I_Gamma
solver does not use E residuals
dual_admissibility_gate: Q_A has signed boundary trace support
falsification_gate: valid component identity residual beats exact-structure nulls

promotion_rules.after_v1691_8_possible: At most Level 1/2 diagnostic if exact-adjoint schema and stationarity pass and nulls are separated.
promotion_rules.not_allowed: No law closure unless component-dual residuals pass exact-structure nulls across seeds/sizes.
